d: Long, wavy dark chocolate brown hair flows from beneath a plush white faux-fur hat, with loose curls framing a mature, youthful face and sharp, olive-green eyes. The lean build is dressed in a structured brown overcoat with white fur lining and a matching brown skirt, worn over a white high-collared blouse and a blue underskirt. A silver chain belt with ornate circular ornaments cinches the waist, complemented by white gloves and dark brown boots.
